name: queens_n22__v0_h
prompt:
Place 22 queens on a 22×22 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 22 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 21) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.

Partial assignment (fixed values that must be respected):
- q[11]=8, q[16]=14, q[18]=11, q[21]=13
Return a complete solution consistent with these fixed assignments.
